mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (warehouse_id, location_id, sku_id, batch_no, qty, locked_qty, frozen_qty, version, production_date, expiry_date, inbound_time, deleted) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{locationId}, #{skuId}, #{batchNo}, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{productionDate}, #{expiryDate}, NOW(3), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET qty = #{qty}, locked_qty = #{lockedQty}, frozen_qty = #{frozenQty}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM inventory WHERE deleted = 0 AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND available_qty > 0 ORDER BY inbound_time ASC, production_date ASC, id ASC
mapper.sql: SELECT i.id, i.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, i.location_id, l.code AS location_code, i.sku_id, p.sku_code, p.name AS sku_name, i.batch_no, i.qty, i.locked_qty, i.frozen_qty, i.available_qty, i.inbound_time, i.production_date, i.expiry_date FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id = i.location_id AND l.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = i.sku_id
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS total_qty, COALESCE(SUM(i.locked_qty), 0) AS locked_qty, COALESCE(SUM(i.frozen_qty), 0) AS frozen_qty, COALESCE(SUM(i.available_qty), 0) AS available_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_id) AS sku_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i.location_id) AS used_location_count FROM inventory i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.qty > 0
AND i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS location_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.capacity > 0 THEN l.capacity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS capacity_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.capacity > 0 THEN l.used_capacity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS capacity_used FROM location l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.status = 'ENABLED'
AND l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED')) AS pending_task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbound_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('CREATED', 'RECEIVING')) AS pending_inbound_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbound_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('CREATED', 'ALLOCATED', 'PICKING')) AS pending_outbound_count
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, i.location_id AS location_id, l.code AS location_code, i.sku_id AS sku_id, p.sku_code AS sku_code, p.name AS sku_name, i.batch_no AS batch_no, i.version AS version, i.qty AS balance_qty, COALESCE(t.calc_qty, 0) AS calculated_qty, i.locked_qty AS balance_locked_qty, COALESCE(t.calc_locked, 0) AS calculated_locked_qty, i.frozen_qty AS balance_frozen_qty, COALESCE(t.calc_frozen, 0) AS calculated_frozen_qty FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN (SELECT location_id, sku_id, batch_no, SUM(qty_change) AS calc_qty, SUM(locked_change) AS calc_locked, SUM(frozen_change) AS calc_frozen FROM inventory_transaction GROUP BY location_id, sku_id, batch_no) t ON t.location_id = i.location_id AND t.sku_id = i.sku_id AND t.batch_no = i.batch_no LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id = i.location_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = i.sku_id WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND (i.qty <> COALESCE(t.calc_qty, 0) OR i.locked_qty <> COALESCE(t.calc_locked, 0) OR i.frozen_qty <> COALESCE(t.calc_frozen, 0)) ORDER BY i.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET qty = #{qty}, locked_qty = #{lockedQty}, frozen_qty = #{frozenQty}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
